issues.problem: Month/week time frames (先月, 先週, 今週) combined with one-off events gave odd sentences ('Last month, only X brought an umbrella / went home early / came to the party'); 風邪をひきました and 早く帰りました also clashed with some time values.
issues.action: Replaced 'when' with day-level times (昨日, 今日, 一昨日, 今朝, 先日, この前) and replaced the clashing events with 休みました, 早く来ました, お弁当を持って来ました (6 x 7 x 7 = 294 combinations). Focus index unchanged at 0.

issues.problem: 寝ませんでした with minute values gave the implausible 'Yesterday X slept for only ten minutes'.
issues.action: Replaced with ピアノを弾きませんでした ('played the piano'); its new slot falls after the focus slot, so f=1 still holds.
